summary: Add metadata-only native harness question reads and fenced person-only positional answers to the CLI and generated clients

replay.detail: No replay or projection rebuild. Existing compact question observations and resolutions remain authoritative.

schema.detail: No database, claim kind, stored receipt format or retention change. Existing hashed native identities, canonical question ids and indefinitely retained compact resolutions are reused.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordination rule change.

compatibility.detail: Add harness-questions.list/get and harness.answer to client-v0. Reads contain ids, option counts and positions only. Answers require terminal.control and current person and live-runtime authority, reject every agent actor, and fence the observation revision and runtime incarnation. Action ids are bounded to 256 UTF-8 bytes before settlement; retained keys conflict across harness and ordinary action receipts. Rust, Swift and TypeScript clients are regenerated from the shared contract.

manual.detail: No production adapter or web answering form is wired. Per-harness and web flags remain off. Enabling requires separate native timeline join, user-interface and authority/relay review.

recovery.detail: Retain the same action id, idempotency key and positional parameters for uncertain retries. Exact accepted retries replay the compact receipt after current authority and snapshot-provenance checks; a new key on an ended question returns already_resolved. Accepted acknowledges native settlement, not a resumed harness turn.
